app.setup.title_default.why: Plain state, matches Apple's on/off phrasing, no instruction leaking in from the button below.

app.setup.title_failed.s: स्थिति की जांच नहीं हो सकी
app.setup.title_failed.why: Hedged, not 'it is off' — reads as a failed check, distinct from the default title.

app.setup.detail_default.s: सुरक्षा चालू होते ही कोई साइट आपके क्लिक पर कब्ज़ा नहीं कर पाएगी।
app.setup.detail_default.back: Protection turning-on as-soon-as, no site your click on hijack not will-be-able-to-do.
app.setup.detail_default.why: One sentence, the whole pitch — verb-final, no slogan register.

app.setup.detail_failed.s: इस बार Safari से जवाब नहीं मिला। एक्सटेंशन चालू करते ही ऐप खुद जान जाएगा।
app.setup.detail_failed.back: This time Safari from answer not got. Extension turning-on as-soon-as app itself will-know.
app.setup.detail_failed.why: Two plain clauses, no error code, reassures without asking the person to come back and check.

app.setup.open_button.why: One verb, works verbatim on both the setup screen and the welcome sheet.

app.welcome.heading.why: Warmer register, the one place allowed it — a first hello, not a status line.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.tit.why: Two concrete nouns, no marketing gloss.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.s: कोई अदृश्य परत असली बटन पर बिछकर आपका टैप कहीं और भेज सकती है।
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.back: Some invisible layer real button on lying-over your tap somewhere else can-send.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.why: Describes what the person would see happen, not the DOM mechanism.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.title.why: Names the trick in two words, mirrors the invisible-layer title's shape.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.s: दबाने और छोड़ने के बीच कुछ पेज लिंक का पता बदल देते हैं।
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.back: Pressing and releasing between, some pages link's address change give.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.why: States the press/release gap plainly, no dash needed in Hindi.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.ti.why: Two words, matches the row's other titles.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.s: सुरक्षा के साथ नया टैब सिर्फ़ वहीं खुलेगा, जहां आपने टैप किया।
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.back: Protection with, new tab only there-only will-open, where you tapped.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.why: Written as a positive promise, not a description of the trick — matches the brief's says field.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.ti.why: Names the rule-list feature: everything is tracked, not only what got caught.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.s: हर गंतव्य की अलग एंट्री बनती है, जिसे आप यहां या हर जगह के लिए तय कर सकते हैं।
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.back: Every destination's separate entry forms, which you here or everywhere for decide can.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.why: Names both scopes (here / everywhere) in one clause, kept under budget.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.t.why: Catchy two-part phrase naming the per-site mechanism, matches the row's tone rather than a technical mode name.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.s: Safari के टूलबार में Undirect बटन दबाकर उस साइट की सुरक्षा चालू करें।
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.back: Safari's toolbar in Undirect button pressing that site's protection turn-on.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.why: States the exact mechanism: the toolbar button, this site only.

app.nav.guarded_sites.why: Two words, fits a narrow sidebar column and works equally as a nav title.

app.nav.settings.why: Apple's own Hindi term for this screen, not a synonym.

app.nav.app_title.why: Proper noun, left untranslated like any other app's own name.

app.rules.grouping.everywhere.why: Reads naturally both as a short sidebar item and as that pane's own title.

app.rules.grouping.by_site.why: Clear opposite of 'हर जगह' when the two sit side by side.

app.rules.empty_no_app.title.why: A wiring/first-contact state, kept distinct from the 'list is genuinely empty' title below.

app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.s: Safari में कोई भी पेज खोलें, सूची अपने आप भर जाएगी।
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.back: Safari in any page open, list on-its-own will-fill.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.why: One simple fix, no setting to change.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.title.why: Plain, short — the list is connected but genuinely empty.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.s: नियम तभी बनता है जब आप कोई फ़ैसला लेते हैं।
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.back: Rule only-then forms when you some decision take.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.why: Explains a rule is created by a decision, not merely by the guard seeing something.

app.rules.footer.lifetime_count.why: One cumulative lifetime figure; %lld kept exactly as named.

app.rules.row.state_blocked.why: Kept as the common borrowed tech term, the way Hindi UI usually keeps it.

app.rules.row.state_allowed.why: Clear opposite of 'ब्लॉक', common in Hindi UI for a granted state.

app.rules.row.action_allow.why: Imperative verb form, distinct from the noun/state word 'स्वीकृत' shown as current state.

app.rules.row.action_block.why: Imperative counterpart to 'अनुमति दें', shown only when the row is currently allowed.

app.rules.row.help_tooltip.s: यहां से ब्लॉक या अनुमति चुनें
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.back: Here from block or permission choose
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.why: Describes the control under the pointer in one short phrase.

app.rules.row.use_default.why: Names what actually happens — deleting the explicit rule — rather than a vaguer 'reset'.

app.watched.empty.title.why: States plainly that nothing has been switched on yet.

app.watched.empty.detail.s: जो साइट परेशान करे, वहां Safari के टूलबार में Undirect बटन दबाएं।
app.watched.empty.detail.back: Which site bothers, there Safari's toolbar in Undirect button press.
app.watched.empty.detail.why: Tells exactly how to guard the first site, tied to the actual trigger (a misbehaving site).

app.watched.footer.s: नई साइट जोड़ने का तरीका सिर्फ़ Safari का टूलबार बटन है।
app.watched.footer.back: New site adding's way only Safari's toolbar button is.
app.watched.footer.why: Reminds the person this screen itself cannot add a site.

app.watched.row.guarded_badge.why: Read-only status word, iOS has no Stop button here.

app.watched.row.stop_button.why: One short imperative verb for a small trailing row button.

app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.s: इस साइट की सुरक्षा बंद करें
app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.why: Describes exactly what the button under the pointer does.

app.settings.guard_toggle.why: The master switch's own name, also the vocabulary's 'guard' concept used consistently throughout the app.

app.settings.state_on.why: Generic on-state word, reused for more than one setting on this screen.

app.settings.mode_heading.why: Section heading introducing the watched-sites-vs-everywhere choice.

app.settings.mode_watched.why: Described from the person's own point of view, not as a technical mode name.

app.settings.banner_toggle.why: Names the on-page banner, separate from the popup's own record.

app.settings.policy_heading.s: बिना नियम वाले गंतव्यों की डिफ़ॉल्ट नीति
app.settings.policy_heading.why: Introduces the choice for a destination that has no rule at all yet.

app.settings.policy_block.why: Short imperative picker option, matches the row-menu action wording elsewhere.

ext.meta.name.why: Proper noun, listed as-is in Safari's Extensions settings and the App Store.

ext.meta.description.s: Undirect उन पेजों को रोकता है जो आपका क्लिक इस्तेमाल कर आपको कहीं और भेज देते हैं।
ext.meta.description.back: Undirect those pages stops which your click using you somewhere else send give.
ext.meta.description.why: One sentence for a first-time reader, plain and concrete, slightly more explanatory register.

ext.meta.app_title.why: Fallback display name, used only when no actual site name is available.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_on.why: Tooltip confirming guarding is active on the tab in front of the person.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.s: सुरक्षा चालू करने के लिए दबाएं
ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.why: Doubles as the call to action — pressing the icon is how guarding starts here.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.s: यहां सुरक्षित करने को कुछ नहीं
ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.why: Explains briefly there is nothing to guard on this tab.

ext.popup.no_site_title.why: Popup headline for the no-website state.

ext.popup.no_site_body.s: कोई वेबसाइट खोलें, फिर यहां दबाकर सुरक्षित करें।
ext.popup.no_site_body.back: Some website open, then here pressing protect do.
ext.popup.no_site_body.why: 'यहां' keeps the self-reference to the toolbar button the popup hangs off, same as the source's 'here'.

ext.popup.watch_switch_label.s: इस साइट के लिए सुरक्षा स्विच
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.why: Screen-reader-only label naming what the switch controls, since the visible row already shows the site name.

ext.popup.watch_unknown.why: Short reason the per-site switch is disabled: nothing here to guard.

ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.s: सेटिंग्स में पहले से हर जगह सुरक्षा चालू है
ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.back: Settings in already every place protection on is
ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.why: Explains the switch is redundant because everywhere-mode is already on elsewhere.

ext.popup.watch_master_off.why: Explains the switch is disabled by the master switch, not by anything about this site.

ext.popup.watch_on.s: सुरक्षा चालू है, बंद करने पर पेज रीलोड होगा।
ext.popup.watch_on.back: Protection on is, off doing on page reload will-happen.
ext.popup.watch_on.why: Confirms current state and warns of the reload, matching the off variant's shape.

ext.popup.watch_off.s: सुरक्षा बंद है, चालू करने पर पेज रीलोड होगा।
ext.popup.watch_off.back: Protection off is, on doing on page reload will-happen.
ext.popup.watch_off.why: Direct before/after counterpart to watch_on, same sentence shape.

ext.popup.page_heading.why: Heads the section listing what the current tab specifically reached for.

ext.popup.page_off.s: सुरक्षा बंद है, इसलिए कुछ दर्ज नहीं हो रहा।
ext.popup.page_off.back: Protection off is, therefore something recorded not happening.
ext.popup.page_off.why: Dead key as of 2026-09-22 per the brief; written speculatively in the same voice as the other page-section states.

ext.popup.page_quiet.s: इस पेज ने अब तक कहीं और पहुंचने की कोशिश नहीं की।
ext.popup.page_quiet.back: This page has so-far somewhere else reach's attempt not made.
ext.popup.page_quiet.why: States plainly that nothing on this page has reached outside so far.

ext.popup.page_empty.s: अभी सूची में कुछ नहीं है।
ext.popup.page_empty.back: Right-now list in something not is.
ext.popup.page_empty.why: Dead key per the brief; treated as a near-synonym of page_quiet, worded around an empty list rather than a quiet page.

ext.popup.stopped_one.why: Singular form (count is always 1); pairs with stopped_other for a natural set.

ext.popup.stopped_other.why: Plural agreement (कोशिशें) for 0 or 2+; pairs with stopped_one.

ext.popup.seen_one.why: Singular total-recorded count, broader than 'stopped' — covers blocked and allowed together.

ext.popup.tries_one.why: 'बार' (times) doesn't inflect for count in Hindi, so this reads naturally for the singular case too.

ext.popup.tries_other.why: Same word as tries_one — Hindi's counter word is invariant, unlike English's times/time split.

ext.popup.recipe_heading.why: Reads as the first half of 'स्वचालित सुधार: <fix name>', matching the code's colon-joined composition.

ext.state.blocked.why: Same reused word as app.rules.row.state_blocked; combines with a following scope fragment written to lead with a comma (see ext.scope.*), since Hindi would otherwise put the scope word first.

ext.state.allowed.why: Kept as a single word so it combines the same way as 'ब्लॉक' with the scope fragments.

ext.state.removed.why: One-word status for a trap taken off the page directly — no destination to rule on here.

ext.scope.here.why: Leads with a comma because Hindi normally puts the location before the verb ('इस साइट पर ब्लॉक'); the code concatenates verdict-then-scope, so the comma bridges the reversed order into a readable telegraphic badge rather than a grammatical sentence.

ext.scope.everywhere.why: Same comma-bridge compromise as scope.here, for the everywhere case.

ext.scope.default.why: Same comma-bridge pattern; 'डिफ़ॉल्ट से' reads as 'by default' following the verdict word.

ext.action.allow_here.why: 'यहां' (here) reads naturally as the current site in this already-open popup, matching the app's own action_allow verb.

ext.action.block_here.why: Here-scoped block option, mirrors allow_here's shape.

ext.action.block_everywhere.why: Everywhere-scoped block option, mirrors allow_everywhere's shape.

ext.popup.policy_heading.s: बिना नियम वाले गंतव्यों की डिफ़ॉल्ट नीति
ext.popup.policy_heading.why: Same concept as the app's settings screen equivalent, written fresh for this separate translation unit.

ext.policy.block.why: Matches the app-side policy_block wording for a consistent reading across both.

ext.popup.bridge_warning.s: इस पेज की सुरक्षा सेटिंग्स के कारण सुरक्षा का एक हिस्सा यहां काम नहीं कर रहा।
ext.popup.bridge_warning.back: This page's security settings because-of protection's one part here work not doing.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.why: Names the page's own policy as the cause, not a bug or a setting the person needs to fix.

ext.kind.click_catcher.why: Short tag naming the specific trick: an invisible clickable trap.

ext.kind.overlay.why: Broader than the click-trap tag — any see-through element over the page.

ext.kind.synthetic_click.why: Names a click the page's own script made up, not a real press.

ext.kind.window_open.why: Kept as the common borrowed term, matches window_open in every app that ships Hindi.

ext.kind.form_submit.why: Names the hidden-form mechanism distinctly from a normal link or window call.

ext.kind.href_swap.why: Names the mid-press address swap specifically.

ext.kind.back_hijack.why: Names a navigation fired right after the person's own back gesture.

ext.kind.redirect.why: Names the core same-tab redirect trick that rides the person's own press.

ext.kind.pop_tab.why: Names a tab-under style new tab, distinct from a plain pop-up window.

ext.kind.network_rule.why: Names the earliest, strongest kind of block — stopped before it ever reached the page.

ext.reason.way_back.s: पता वापसी का रास्ता दिखाता है
ext.reason.way_back.why: Explains the redirect's own address carried a way back to the original site.

ext.reason.sized.why: Explains the window asked for a deliberate size, not a bare full tab.

ext.reason.took_press.why: Names the core hijack pattern in one vivid, short phrase, within the tight character budget.

ext.reason.default_allow.why: Explains the destination went through only because nothing said to stop it.

ext.reason.own_code.s: साइट के अपने कोड ने खोली
ext.reason.own_code.why: Explains the window was opened by the site's own script, which counts as the site vouching for it.

ext.popup.rules_link.why: One word, reused as the nav row, the screen's own header, and the back button's accessible label.

ext.popup.back_link.why: Standard back-button accessibility label, understood with no visual context.

ext.rules.everywhere_heading.why: Matches app.rules.grouping.everywhere for a consistent reading between app and popup.

ext.rules.empty.why: Terse single-row placeholder, shorter than the app-side empty title since this sits inside a compact list.

ext.action.allow.why: Simpler context than the here/everywhere variants — scope is already fixed by which section the row sits in.

ext.action.block.why: Counterpart to action_allow within the same row menu.

ext.action.clear.why: Same underlying action as app.rules.row.use_default, phrased the same way for a consistent reading.

ext.popup.settings_heading.why: Matches app.nav.settings; reused as both the nav row and this sub-screen's own header.

ext.settings.guard_label.why: Matches app.settings.guard_toggle; used both as the visible row text and the switch's sr-only label.

ext.settings.guard_on.why: Generic on-word, specific to the guard switch in this context.

ext.settings.mode_heading.why: Matches app.settings.mode_heading for a consistent reading across app and popup.

ext.settings.banner_toggle.why: Tighter than the app-side version (same setting) to fit the popup's smaller toggle row.

ext.action.report.why: Names the action plainly: opens a pre-filled report the person still has to submit themselves.
